   287→        """

   290→
   291→        try:

   293→        except Exception as err:

   295→

   298→        audio: list[Representation | None] = [None] if with_video_only else []

   301→        for aset in mpd.periods[period].adaptationSets:
   302→            if aset.contentProtections:
   303→                raise PluginError(f"{source} is protected by DRM")
   304→            for rep in aset.representations:

   307→                if rep.mimeType.startswith("video"):

   310→                    audio.append(rep)

   314→        if not audio:
   315→            audio.append(None)

   318→        locale_lang = locale.language
   319→        lang = None
   320→        available_languages = set()

from streamlink.utils.parse import parse_xml


def test_mpd_url_base_directory_is_used_for_relative_paths():
    # Minimal static MPD with relative SegmentTemplate paths and no BaseURL elements
    mpd_xml = """
    <MPD xmlns="urn:mpeg:dash:schema:mpd:2011"
         type="static"
         profiles="urn:mpeg:dash:profile:isoff-on-demand:2011"
         minBufferTime="PT1S"
         mediaPresentationDuration="PT10S">
      <Period>
        <AdaptationSet mimeType="video/mp4">
          <Representation id="v1" bandwidth="1000000">
            <SegmentTemplate
                initialization="video_1920x1080_avc1/init.mp4"
                media="video_1920x1080_avc1/video-v1-$Number$.m4s"
                startNumber="1"
                duration="1"
                timescale="1" />
          </Representation>
        </AdaptationSet>
      </Period>
    </MPD>
    """

    node = parse_xml(mpd_xml, ignore_ns=True)

    # MPD URL ends with a filename and has no query string
    mpd_url = "https://example.com/mdrm/CH_TNTHD/manifest.mpd"

    # Do not pass base_url here: it must be derived from the MPD document URL
    mpd = MPD(node, url=mpd_url)

    # The derived base URL must be the MPD's parent directory, not include 'manifest.mpd/'
    assert mpd.base_url == "https://example.com/mdrm/CH_TNTHD/"
    assert "manifest.mpd/" not in mpd.base_url

    # Verify that joining relative segment paths does not insert 'manifest.mpd/'
    rep = mpd.periods[0].adaptationSets[0].representations[0]
    segs = rep.segments()

    # initialization segment
    init_seg = next(segs)
    assert init_seg.uri == "https://example.com/mdrm/CH_TNTHD/video_1920x1080_avc1/init.mp4"

    # first media segment (Number=1)
    first_media = next(segs)
    assert first_media.uri == "https://example.com/mdrm/CH_TNTHD/video_1920x1080_avc1/video-v1-1.m4s"
